name: kpi-calc
description: Machine Fleet manager (WinCC OA JavaScript Manager): records each symbol's state and stop cause (MachineFleet3D_State_<symbol>, the history of the Gantt, the stops and the TRS), sends the stop-cause catalogue to the machines, and computes TRS, MTBF and MTTR from that history. Formerly the fleetState and kpiCalc managers. No dependency.
